t: This is the equestrian statue of George III, a Grade II listed monument at the junction of Pall Mall and Cockspur Street. It shows the king on horseback and was made by Matthew Cotes Wyatt, a painter and sculptor from the well-known Wyatt family. George III reigned from 1760 until his death in 1820. He was the first monarch of the House of Hanover who was born in Great Britain, spoke English as his first language, and never visited Hanover. He became King of Hanover in 1814.
